$comment: Approved LaTeX resume templates. Only entries with status 'active' AND license.commercialUseReviewed = true are shown to students and compiled. Each entry has a folder resume-templates/<id>/. See resume-templates/README.md before adding one. Supplied originals are kept unchanged in resume-templates/_originals/.

templates.name: Classic ATS
templates.description: Clean single-column layout with small-caps section headings and right-aligned dates. Suits most roles, especially software and engineering.

ats.notes: Real-text headings, Unicode text mapping, no icons or images.

templates.name: Modern Minimal
templates.description: The same proven single-column structure set in the modern Lato typeface for a lighter, contemporary look.

ats.notes: Original custom-commands.tex was not supplied; uses the MIT sb2nov/Jake macros it derives from. Icons intentionally not printed.

templates.name: Simple CV
templates.description: Traditional A4 CV with a centred blue name, ruled section titles and Times-style typography.

license.name: Unknown - no author or licence included with the supplied file

ats.notes: Hidden from students until its licence is confirmed. \textBF made breakable; glyphtounicode added for text extraction.
